title: auth-resource Feature Generator
description: Adds a bearer token check to the FHIR endpoint of an existing HAPI FHIR server

project.description: Name of the Nx server project to add the feature to

issuer.description: Token issuer URL. The iss claim of a token must be equal to it. The default is https://udap-security.fast.hl7.org, and the generator applies it.

audience.description: Value that the aud claim of a token must contain.
